44.t: 1. Select “COIN OPTIONS” on the menu screen to set the game cost and related settings. The following screen is displayed.
2. Use the Select Up/Down switch choose the required item then press the Enter button.
3. Use the Select Up/Down switch to change the setting.
4. Press the Enter button to return to option select mode.
5. Select “EXIT” and press the Enter button to return to the menu screen.
The price of play on this machine is set within the Cashflow Coin Mech. Ensure that the Game Cost is set to 1 Coin 1 Credit.
